We attached an internal requirements doc (terragen_standby_requirements_v2.pdf) with the following asks: 

- Add a geographically separate standby cluster in AWS us-west-2 for DR

Naomi / Evelyn — quick technical note from infra on capacity and cost trade-offs. High level: we can do what you asked, but sizing and cache warmup behavior drive both latency during failover and token cost.

- Proposed standby topology: 3x inference nodes + 2x control/coord nodes in us-west-2 (same instance sku as primary) to mirror production load during failover.
- Cache warmup: warm KV cache requires either a scheduled sync or a short pre-warm phase; without pre-warm, first-hour requests post-failover will be 2–4x cost.
- Billing model options:
  1) Pilot seats (30 days): 50% of committed node rate (Evelyn suggested) — good for evaluating failover without changing term immediately.
  2) Commit + standby parked (recommended for reliability): charged at 20% of node rate when standby is idle; full rate when active. Requires a 12-month minimum commit addendum.

Estimated monthly run-rate (ballpark): pilot option: ~$18k/mo for the pilot cluster (discounted rate) vs commit addendum: incremental $7.6k/mo (parked) + full active costs when used. I'll attach an internal cost excel in the SOW draft.

If TerraGen prefers the canary approach, we can provision within 10 business days after signed SOW + PO. If you want the commit route, finance/legal will need a short amendment to the existing order.

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
